title: Remediation
description: Actionable, text-only remediation guidance for a CONFIRMED finding. Produced in 10_remediation_analysis. Never applied automatically -- see .claude/rules/security.md 'Absolute Read-Only Policy'.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what to do.

explanation.description: What is vulnerable, why, and how an attacker could exploit it -- framed for remediation, not re-stating the finding's exploitation_scenario verbatim.

fix_guidance.description: Specific, framework-aware guidance on how to fix it.

verification_steps.description: How the team can confirm the fix actually closes the gap (e.g. a specific test case, a manual repro step, a scanner re-run).
